text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Progress is... rather hard... to
come by...
Isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes... My legs feel... slightly heavier...
than
normal... That's all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I may... move a touch... slower... than
usual...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
However... it is but... a trifle... in the
face... of
victory... I shall... persevere...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The non-stop racing has taken its toll on
her... I
should probably adjust her
schedule.
